description:
Export 3 specific papers to a BibTeX file named 'info_theory_foundations.bib' in the Documents folder.

Target Papers:
1. 'A Mathematical Theory of Communication' (Shannon, 1948)
2. 'A Method for the Construction of Minimum-Redundancy Codes' (Huffman, 1952)
3. 'On Computable Numbers, with an Application to the Entscheidungsproblem' (Turing, 1936)

Steps:
1. Locate these 3 papers in your library.
2. Select all three simultaneously (hold Ctrl or Cmd/Shift while clicking).
3. Right-click the selection and choose 'Export Items...'.
4. Select 'BibTeX' format.
5. Save the file exactly as '/home/ga/Documents/info_theory_foundations.bib'.

target_papers.title: A Method for the Construction of Minimum-Redundancy Codes
target_papers.author: Huffman
